body:
> Consolidation note, 22 October 2026: this remains a historical source/evidence review. [#260](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/pull/260) subsequently qualified the bounded scalar repair; [#261](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/pull/261) retains the negative result for that repair as the principal remaining S1 cause. Its 0/60 both-conditioned screen is backend agreement, including shared e10216-01 global nonconvergence, not 60 accurate motion estimates. The [census qualifications](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/pull/255#pullrequestreview-5593341658) distinguish 30 movies from 60 configurations and retain regressions. These updates add no native experiment or scientific PASS.

## Purpose
Publish an independent, self-contained review of MotionCorr Standalone's CPU/CUDA numerical divergence and correctness risks, with pinned code links and clear evidence boundaries.

## Included
- **[Full illustrated report](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/f62572947572259abd197c1deaa024c3a1020e13/docs/post_rc0/numerical_correctness_audit/README.md)**: motion-correction pipeline, precise error stage, mechanism, provenance, proposed fix and remaining test for each finding.
- **Three committed SVG charts**: five production S1 image-relative-RMSE cases; fit-field changes with common accepted patch sets; same-input peak curvature replay.
- **Two Mermaid diagrams**: pipeline stage ownership and causal paths from upstream numerical differences through near-tied peaks, acceptance and corrected images.
- Pinned source links for each finding; references to #250, #238, #232 and #70. No Notion links.

## Review highlights
1. Non-Hermitian spectra can reach global and dose-weighted C2R; reduced CCF geometry is a separate unproven S1 risk. Contract violation is distinct from routine FFTW/cuFFT roundoff.
2. CUDA subpixel curvature loses avoidable precision even for identical captured CCF samples. Stable-denominator results are **host replays**, not validated patched GPU output.
3. Patch-set/trajectory decisions amplify differences; fit-only controls do not establish a broken solver or improved reconstructed images.
4. Independent correctness concerns: unbracketed boundary peak fit, centred-coordinate guard, float border interpolation branch, transformed EER gain semantics, and STAR coefficient serialization.

## Evidence boundaries
Documentation and SVG assets **only**. No production code, CMake, numerical tolerances, benchmark gates, release designation or algorithms changed. No new native GPU experiment or downstream CTF/FSC result is claimed. CPU parity is not equated with scientific ground truth. Do not merge as an implicit closure of S1.3/S1.4.

Related: #238, #232, #70, #250.

Original report snapshot: [4731f46f](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/4731f46fbb73f1a7decb871267f37e35632c5a4f/docs/post_rc0/numerical_correctness_audit/README.md).
